response.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR p.death_country = '' THEN NULL ELSE p.death_country END AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR p.death_country = '' THEN NULL ELSE p.death_country END), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) AS mean_group_average FROM group_averages) SELECT g.death_country, g.avg_points_won, ABS(g.avg_points_won - o.mean_group_average) AS distance_from_mean_group_average FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o

assumptions.assumption: NULL and empty-string death countries form one blank group. If every points_won value in a group is missing, its undefined average is excluded from the average of group averages.
